decisions.why: HoverMatt is an inflatable air transfer mattress used for lateral bed-to-bed/trolley transfer (split-leg, air transfer mattress, link) - functionally a transfer aid despite the product name, not a pressure-care positioning mattress
HoverJack is an inflatable air patient lift used to raise a fallen patient off the floor, functioning as a hoist/standing-aid alternative
HoverSling split-leg and repositioning sheet are slings used with hoists
